### **Vasaka Powder – 100g | Traditional Ayurvedic Herb**  
Rooted in ancient Ayurvedic wisdom, **Vasaka Powder** is prepared from the dried leaves of _Adhatoda vasica_, a herb revered in traditional Indian systems. Known in Sanskrit as _Vasaka_ or _Adulsa_, this botanical has been incorporated into daily rituals and herbal preparations across generations.  

In Ayurvedic tradition, Vasaka is understood to have a balancing influence on _Kapha_ and _Pitta_ energies. Its subtle properties are traditionally valued for their role in maintaining internal harmony during seasonal transitions.  

This finely ground powder offers a pure, unadulterated form of the herb — ideal for those who prefer traditional methods of herbal use. It can be blended with warm water, honey, or other supportive herbs as part of a personal wellness routine, following customary practices.
